entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Holy Trinity Monastery of Pljevlja is a medieval Serbian Orthodox monastery complex (lavra) in Pljevlja, Montenegro. It is located about 60 kilometres (37 mi) north of Durmitor, and 39 kilometres (24 mi) from Đurđevića Tara Bridge.
